name: soul-lite-do
description: Child of soul-lite, run on opus-4.8 via the parent's spawn model override. Branches on the haiku classification (inherited): if ref topics apply, READ_REFS then BARE_DO_IT; otherwise BARE_DO_IT directly. Both prompts run in this one opus session.

read_refs.name: READ_REFS
read_refs.prompt:
<sys>
Read the reference doc(s) for these topics: {{refTopics}}.
They live under /home/pride/coding-projects/leo-axi/prompts/refs/ (Scheduling -> scheduling.md, Agent spawning -> agent-spawning.md). Use the Read tool to read the relevant file(s). Do NOT respond to the user yet — just read and absorb the material.
</sys>

bare_do.name: BARE_DO_IT
bare_do.prompt:
<sys>
Your response goes to the user. Do exactly what the user's message asks, using anything you just read. Be concise.
</sys>
<user>
$5
</user>
